user.title: Connect to your WhatsApp bridge
user.description: The bridge is a small local service that links Home Assistant to WhatsApp as a companion device, the same way WhatsApp Web and WhatsApp Desktop do. Enter its address and API token.

pair.title: Link your WhatsApp account
pair.description: Choose how to link this Home Assistant instance. You can also finish setup now and pair later from the integration options.

qr.title: Scan this QR code
qr.description: Open WhatsApp on your phone and go to **Settings → Linked devices → Link a device**, then scan the code below. Press **Submit** after scanning. If the code expired, a fresh one is shown.

phone.title: Link with a phone number
phone.description: Enter the WhatsApp phone number in international format, for example {example}. WhatsApp shows an 8-character code on the next screen.

phone_code.title: Enter this code on your phone

reauth_confirm.title: Update the bridge token
reauth_confirm.description: The WhatsApp bridge at {url} rejected the stored API token. Enter the current token.

reconfigure.title: Update the bridge connection
reconfigure.description: Change the bridge URL or API token. The account pairing is kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the WhatsApp bridge. Check that it is running and the URL is correct.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge rejected the API token.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL.
error.invalid_phone: Enter a phone number in international format, including the country code.
error.pairing_timeout: WhatsApp did not provide a QR or pairing code in time. Try again.
error.pairing_failed: Could not complete pairing. Check the bridge log and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This WhatsApp bridge is already configured.
abort.qr_unavailable: The bridge did not return a QR code. Check the bridge log and try again.

settings.title: WhatsApp Web settings
settings.description: The polling interval is only a fallback: messages and unread counts are pushed over a WebSocket.

data.fire_outgoing_events: Fire events for messages sent from the phone

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Send a text message from the linked WhatsApp account.

entry_id.name: Account
entry_id.description: WhatsApp account to use. Optional when only one is configured.

to.name: Recipient
to.description: Phone number in international format, a contact JID, or a group JID.

mark_read.name: Mark chat as read
mark_read.description: Mark a chat as read and clear its unread counter.

entry_id.name: Account
entry_id.description: WhatsApp account to use. Optional when only one is configured.

message_ids.name: Message IDs
message_ids.description: Specific message IDs to mark as read. Defaults to the tracked unread messages.

send_typing.name: Send typing indicator
send_typing.description: Show or clear a typing indicator in a WhatsApp chat.

entry_id.name: Account
entry_id.description: WhatsApp account to use. Optional when only one is configured.

state.name: State
state.description: Whether to show or clear the typing indicator.
